# Save inventory: every write path of the save script

Made from the code by `node tools/save-inventory.js --write <this file>`; `tests/practice-run.test.js` fails when this table and the code disagree. The LIVE column is typed in the tool (a Script Property cannot be read from the repository). Every save also needs `SAVE_ENABLED` = `true`; each switch is a Script Property set to the word `true`, anything else is off.

<!-- inventory:start (made by tools/save-inventory.js; do not edit by hand) -->
